subject: Carlisle Health — trial plan, success metrics & decision timeline
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@carlislehealth.com>, Samantha Ray <s.ray@carlislehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 1 Aug 2024 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Carlisle Health — trial plan, success metrics & decision timeline

Hi Liam / Samantha — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Summary of needs (call takeaways)
- Primary use case: clinician note summarization + structured extraction for coding prep.
- Target throughput: ~600 notes/day to start, with spikes up to 1,500/day for batch processing.
- Data sensitivity: PHI; Carlisle needs private VPC option and audit logs.
- Decision criteria: accuracy on extraction (entity precision >= 88%), end-to-end latency < 350ms median for single-note inference, and clear logging/auditability for compliance

Proposed trial scope (6 weeks) — high level
1) Week 0: onboarding + test data transfer (SFTP or secure upload)
2) Week 1–3: baseline runs, model tuning, and alignment of prompt templates
3) Week 4–5: integration with batch pipeline + sampling live traffic
4) Week 6: final readout, decision meeting with execs (go / no-go)

Owners (Redwood)
- Technical onboarding & benchmarks: Sean Gallagher
- Success metrics / customer liaison: Marissa Cole
- Contract & procurement coordination: Stephanie Nguyen

Requested items from Carlisle
- Two sample data batches (de-identified or production with a signed DPA) by Aug 5
- Procurement contact and PO process so we can prepare MSA/DSA template
- Exec readout slot week of Aug 12–16 (we've tentatively penciled Aug 15)

Attachments: trial-success-matrix.xlsx (success metrics template), mutual-action-plan.docx (editable MAP)

Ask: please confirm owners on your side, feasibility of the Aug 5 sample delivery, and whether Aug 15 (10:00am PT) works for an initial exec readout.

I'll follow up internally and send invites once we have confirmation.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: trial-success-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: mutual-action-plan.docx (word doc)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@carlislehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Ray <s.ray@carlislehealth.com>, procurement@carlislehealth.com
Date: Thu, 1 Aug 2024 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Carlisle Health — trial plan, success metrics & decision timeline

Thanks Hannah — that recap is helpful. A few notes / questions from our side: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance: we need to see a SOC 2 Type II report and a short description of your data retention and deletion process (especially around logs). Can your security team share standard answers or a short package?
2) Data delivery: we can deliver a de-identified sample (5k notes) by Aug 6, but any production access will require a signed DSA. Can you send the DSA draft?
3) Procurement: copied procurement@ — they will want an estimate for committed usage and the MSA template. If you can send a rough cost estimate for the 6-week trial and the MSA/DSA drafts, I can route it through procurement.
4) Meeting: Aug 15 works better for our execs than Aug 12. Would 10:00am PT on Aug 15 be OK? If not, propose alternatives (Aug 14 afternoon or Aug 16 morning).

Also looping in Samantha to confirm the internal owners: Samantha will be the project lead on our side; procurement is the contracting lead.

Appreciate the speedy turnaround.

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
VP of Product | Carlisle Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@carlislehealth.com>, Samantha Ray <s.ray@carlislehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Aug 2024 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Carlisle Health — trial plan, success metrics & decision timeline

Thanks Hannah / Liam — quick internal note on resourcing and timing: 

- Sean: I'll hand the technical onboarding to you. Please prepare a checklist for Week 0 that includes SFTP creds, schema mapping, and a baseline synthetic run so we can validate the pipeline within 48 hours of data receipt.
- Marissa (me): I will own the success metric reports and the dashboard. I'll build the first-week baseline report and a rolling evaluation dashboard for weekly syncs.
- Stephanie: please prepare an MSA + a DSA template to send to procurement. If procurement needs a redline, have legal's standard playbook ready (we can offer a 30-day trial SOW with limited liability for PHI test data).

Sean — action items for you:
- Draft onboarding checklist and estimate of time to first benchmark (hours) by EOD Aug 2.
- Confirm if we can run with de-identified data initially and what additional steps are required for production PHI (KMS/HSM, VPC setup).

Hannah — I'll prepare the week-by-week metric dashboard template and initial synthetic baseline by Aug 6. Once we have the DSA draft, we should be able to run the de-identified batch.

Quote from Liam's note for context: 
> we can deliver a de-identified sample (5k notes) by Aug 6

I'll coordinate a short internal playbook so our exec readout is crisp — we should leave room for a quick live demo and the decision rubric.

-Marissa
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

Hi all — thanks for the confirmations and the clear asks. Finalizing next steps below so we have a single source of truth before I send invites and the contract link.

Confirmed schedule
- Data delivery: de-identified sample (5k notes) by Aug 6 — status: received & validated (Marissa)
- Onboarding Week 0: Aug 7–9 (SFTP + schema mapping) — Sean lead
- Benchmarks: Aug 10–16 (baseline runs & prompt tuning)
- Integration testing with batch pipeline: Aug 17–23
- Final exec readout: Aug 15, 2024 at 10:00am PT (45 min) — please see calendar invite pending acceptance

Contract / procurement steps
- Stephanie attached MSA + DSA drafts to the shared Drive (link below). Procurement, please comment by Aug 13 so legal can prioritize redlines.
- DocuSign link for the trial SOW (non-binding trial SOW) — https://docusign.com/agreements/CH-2024-TRIAL-01

Security / compliance
- Marissa: SOC 2 Type II package and a short data-retention summary were uploaded to the Drive folder.
- For production PHI access we will need KMS integration and VPC peering; Sean to provide a short runbook by Aug 9.

Deliverables & deadlines
- Aug 6: sample data (done)
- Aug 9: onboarding checklist completed (Sean)
- Aug 13: procurement comments on DSA / MSA
- Aug 15: exec readout and go/no-go decision

Attachments: trial-success-matrix.xlsx, mutual-action-plan.docx
Shared links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cTrialOnboarding, https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/companies/67890

If that all looks correct I'll send the calendar invite and the DocuSign SOW this afternoon. Looking forward to a smooth trial.

Best,
Hannah
